findings.summary: gitea_api() got an explicit --max-time (1800s for POST/data calls, 60s for GET) but gh_api() has no --max-time/--connect-timeout at all. The brief asks to 'bound how long any single request can run' for the API-call helpers generally, not just the migrate call. gh_api() drives the enumeration pagination loop (potentially several sequential calls); if api.github.com accepts the TCP connection but stalls (a slow-loris-style hang or a partial response), curl will block indefinitely with no ceiling, so the nightly cron run can hang forever on the very first phase of the script -- the exact failure mode the timeout requirement was meant to close.
